title: 課堂互動
description: 課堂上師生互動的常用對話

sentences.en: Please open your book to page 25.
Did you finish your homework?
Please hand in your assignment by Friday.
Pay attention to the whiteboard.
Raise your hand if you have a question.
Let's take a five-minute break.
Please be quiet during the lesson.
Can you repeat that, please?
Today we will learn about grammar.
Please work in pairs.
Does anyone know the answer?
Please write this down in your notebook.
sentences.zh: 請把這個記在筆記本上。

sentences.en: The class is dismissed.
Let's review what we learned last time.
sentences.zh: 讓我們複習上次學的內容。

sentences.en: Please don't talk while I'm speaking.
sentences.zh: 我在講話時請不要說話。

sentences.en: Who would like to read the next paragraph?
Please come to the front of the class.
Turn to your partner and discuss.
sentences.zh: 轉向你的夥伴討論一下。

sentences.en: I will collect your papers at the end of class.
sentences.zh: 我會在下課時收你們的考卷。

sentences.en: Please sit down and get ready for class.
Let's go over the instructions together.
sentences.zh: 讓我們一起看一下指示。

sentences.en: You need to finish this before next class.
sentences.zh: 你需要在下次上課前完成這個。

sentences.en: Can everyone see the screen?
sentences.zh: 每個人都看得到螢幕嗎？

sentences.en: Please take out your textbook.
I'll explain the rules of the activity.
Let's do a quick warm-up exercise.
sentences.zh: 讓我們做個簡短的暖身練習。

sentences.en: Who wants to share their answer?
Please listen carefully to the instructions.
We're going to watch a short video.
Make sure you write your name on the paper.
sentences.zh: 確保你在紙上寫上名字。
